text:
maria: Trying the new nextjs-llamacpp starter and hit a weird Edge/runtime issue when using the KV caching snippet. Anyone seen this before?
noah: what's the exact error?
maria: On deploy to Vercel Edge (and locally with edge runtime), the wasm instantiate throws:
```
Error: WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming is not a function
    at /edge/handler.js:45:21
```
maria: The starter uses fetch + instantiateStreaming in /lib/llama-wasm.js. We fall back to arrayBuffer in node but apparently Edge runtime in some regions doesn't have instantiateStreaming.
sam: hmm, we added that to keep startup faster. Fallback should be present though. Can you paste the snippet?
maria: Paste: ```
const res = await fetch('/models/ggml-q4_0.bin');
const wasm = await WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming(res, imports);
```
maria: Quick patch I used: 
```
const b = await (await fetch('/models/ggml-q4_0.bin')).arrayBuffer();
const wasm = await WebAssembly.instantiate(b, imports);
```
maria: That fixed the instantiate error but then the runtime can't access global TextEncoder/TextDecoder in the Edge function and crashes on tokenization.
olivia: Edge runtime differences strike again :grimacing: We should detect runtime and polyfill TextEncoder/TextDecoder, or move that part to the API route (server) where node has it.
noah: Also saw something else — the Next starter's README suggests using the Redwood JS SDK for embeddings, but the JS SDK in the starter version lacks an embeddings.create wrapper (we only expose text.generate). That caused extra confusion during onboarding.
sam: Oof, SDK parity mismatch. Which SDK version are you using?
maria: package.json has "@redwood/inference-js": "0.9.1-starter" from the template. The quickstart uses:```js
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed', input: '...' })
```
but runtime throws "client.embeddings is undefined"
olivia: We recently refactored the client to flatten endpoints (client.createEmbedding) in 0.10+, and didn't bump the starter. Starter should pin or update and README callouts fixed.
maria: That explains it. It felt like two separate onboarding bugs: wasm+edge runtime + SDK shape mismatch. New devs will throw up their hands.
devex-bot: New starter published: nextjs-llamacpp-browser v0.2.0 — CI failed on Node 18 linters (build #1245)
sam: Also a minor retry behavior oddity: the fetch wrapper in starter wraps fetch with exponential backoff but doesn't treat 429 as retryable when X-RateLimit-Reset header present. So client gives up on 429s.
noah: We should treat 429 with retry-after or X-RateLimit-Reset as retryable for short windows, especially for hosted sandbox users.
olivia: Action items: 1) update starter to use safe arrayBuffer fallback + polyfills or server-side tokenization. 2) pin SDK or update starter to 0.10+ and adjust example calls. 3) fix fetch retry logic to respect 429/Retry-After/X-RateLimit-Reset. 4) add a small integration test in CI that runs the sample (edge emulation) to catch instantiateStreaming/TextEncoder issues.
maria: I'll open a PR with the arrayBuffer fallback + small TextEncoder polyfill and update README to match the SDK shape.
sam: I'll file an eng ticket for the retry logic parity and a devex task to bump the starter deps and run integration CI.
noah: If you want me to pair on the PR I can. Also propose adding a troubleshooting section in the README: "Edge runtime gotchas" listing these exact errors.
maria: Thanks! I'll include logs and the minimal repro.
olivia: Can we also add a one-liner in the onboarding checklist that verifies client.embeddings vs client.createEmbedding so SEs don't copy-paste wrong snippets?
sam: Yep. Small docs note + changelog entry.
maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/nextjs-llamacpp-starter/pull/78 — includes fixes + updated packages, tests, and an annotated README.
noah: Nice. I'll review. :thumbsup:
maria: Follow-up note: the CI runner for the starter doesn't emulate Edge perfectly; we added a tiny node script to run in Node 18 + Vercel Edge emulation in the PR so we catch TextEncoder and instantiateStreaming fallbacks.
olivia: Great. This should reduce onboarding friction.
devex-bot: PR #78 merged by maria — changelog: starter: fix wasm instantiate fallback, bump SDK to 0.10.1, fix fetch retry handling.
maria: Closing this thread — thanks for the help! :partyparrot:
